raw_text: Doordarshan and PIB have issued categorical denials of a viral video clip showing a fake DD News broadcast announcing curfew orders for multiple Indian cities. 'No such broadcast was aired by Doordarshan at any time. The video is entirely fabricated using AI technology,' a Doordarshan spokesperson said. The synthetic news anchor has no matching identity in any broadcast archive, confirming the video is AI-generated.
clean_text: Doordarshan and PIB categorically denied fake DD News broadcast announcing curfew. Spokesperson confirmed video is entirely fabricated using AI technology with a synthetic news anchor.
